name: ASAM 58th Annual Conference 2027
description: The ASAM 58th Annual Conference, Innovations in Addiction Medicine and Science, is scheduled for April 8 to 11, 2027 in Minneapolis. The online schedule also lists region meetings and preconference activity beginning April 6.

deadlines.label: Poster abstract submission
deadlines.note: Estimated from the 2026 pattern (57th conference deadline Friday, January 23, 2026, notifications mid February); the 2027 call for abstracts has not been posted

sources.note: Site banner reads ASAM 58th Annual Conference, April 8 to 11, 2027, Minneapolis, MN
Schedule days listed Tuesday April 6 through Sunday April 11, 2027, Central Time
2026 call for poster abstracts: deadline January 23, 2026; conference April 23 to 26, 2026 at Manchester Grand Hyatt San Diego

notes: The aggregator eMedEvents lists this meeting as November 4 to 7, 2027 at the Minneapolis Convention Center; the official site banner shows April 8 to 11, 2027, so the official dates are used. Venue not stated on the official site.
